# Project guidance

This project is a beginner-friendly static webpage built with plain HTML and CSS.

## Expectations
- Keep the code simple and easy to read for students learning web basics.
- Prefer semantic HTML and clear class names.
- Use plain CSS and simple layout patterns. Avoid advanced techniques like CSS grid unless explicitly requested.
- Use Flexbox only when it fits the project; keep styling readable and beginner-focused.
- Add short comments to explain important sections and behaviors.

## Project context
- The site is a single-page timeline-style landing page for Intel sustainability.
- Main files are [index.html](../index.html) and [style.css](../style.css).
- Use local assets from [img](../img) when possible.
- There are no build tools or frameworks to run; this is a static site.

## Coding rules
- Do not introduce JavaScript frameworks, build steps, or package installs.
- Keep edits small and targeted.
- Match the existing visual style and beginner-friendly tone.
- Prefer working directly in the page structure and CSS instead of overengineering solutions.
